title: Virtual Radiosonde Plotter: Atmospheric Sounding Analysis & Skew-T Visualization Tool
description: A professional desktop application for downloading atmospheric weather model profiles (Open-Meteo ERA5 / Forecast), performing MetPy thermodynamic calculations (CAPE, CIN, PWAT, LCL, LFC, EL), generating publication-quality Skew-T Log-P diagrams, and exporting data to CSV and native RAOB (.rsf, .env) software formats.
